verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kick's built-in AI automates specific bookkeeping steps, such as auto-categorizing about 97% of transactions and transfer matching logged under a "Kick agent". That is a fixed automation feature, not an in-product assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to. The natural-language delegation surfaces (MCP, CLI, Google Sheets AI) all depend on external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini, so they do not count as a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
